ns2:section.sectionText: ENGL 301 - This course will introduce you to all the lenses you can put on to use to read texts in different ways. We call these lenses critical theory. We will take a very historical approach to each lens, examining why it developed and the debates surrounding it. On the menu: critical race theory, postcolonialism, queer theory, feminism, disability studies, dialogism, formalism, and quantitative. We’ll practice these readings on all forms of texts, not just literature, so students can see they work everywhere. I want students to know that I read Foucault for Dummies in graduate school when I didn’t understand the reading. We will do WHATEVER IT TAKES to learn this stuff, which is actually super fun once it clicks.
